svg.aria-label: STAM running. Samples arrive and pull the three nearest anchors, weighted by mass so heavy anchors resist. A window of error signs is shown; when their Shannon entropy falls below 0.7 the anchor splits, and the Gabriel graph rewires.
svg.text: STAM · LEARNING ONLINE, ONE SAMPLE AT A TIME
Sign of the last 12 errors, not their size.
Radius is mass. Heavy anchors stop moving.
THE TARGET STEPS AT u=0.62 · ANCHORS ON THE STEP GET ONE-SIDED ERRORS AND SPLIT · ANCHORS IN NOISE STAY PUT · REAL RULES, SYNTHETIC DATA
